mapper.select: SELECT r.cake_size AS cakeSize, r.cake_id AS cakeId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM reservations r WHERE r.res_date = #{today} AND r.pickup_status = 'WAITING' GROUP BY r.cake_size, r.cake_id
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.id DESC) AS rowNumber, r.*, c.flavor AS cakeFlavor FROM reservations r JOIN cakes c ON r.cake_id = c.id ORDER BY r.id DESC
SELECT id, flavor FROM cakes
SELECT r.*, c.flavor AS cakeFlavor FROM reservations r JOIN cakes c ON r.cake_id = c.id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT r.*, c.flavor AS cakeFlavor FROM reservations r JOIN cakes c ON r.cake_id = c.id WHERE r.res_date = #{today} AND r.pickup_status = 'WAITING' AND r.make_status = 'READY' AND r.cake_id = #{cakeId} AND r.cake_size = #{cakeSize} ORDER BY r.res_time DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.id DESC) AS rowNumber, r.*, c.flavor AS cakeFlavor FROM reservations r JOIN cakes c ON r.cake_id = c.id WHERE r.contact LIKE CONCAT('%', #{suffix}) ORDER BY r.id DESC

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.res_date ASC, r.res_time ASC) AS rowNumber, r.*, c.flavor AS cakeFlavor FROM reservations r JOIN cakes c ON r.cake_id = c.id WHERE r.pickup_status = #{pickupStatus} AND r.res_date = CURRENT_DATE() ORDER BY r.res_date ASC, r.res_time ASC

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.res_date ASC, r.res_time ASC) AS rowNumber, r.*, c.flavor AS cakeFlavor FROM reservations r JOIN cakes c ON r.cake_id = c.id WHERE r.pickup_status = 'WAITING' AND r.res_date = #{date} ORDER BY r.res_date ASC, r.res_time ASC

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.res_date ASC, r.res_time ASC) AS rowNumber, r.*, c.flavor AS cakeFlavor FROM reservations r JOIN cakes c ON r.cake_id = c.id WHERE r.pickup_status = 'WAITING' AND r.res_date >= CURRENT_DATE() ORDER BY r.res_date ASC, r.res_time ASC

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.res_date ASC, r.res_time ASC) AS rowNumber, r.*, c.flavor AS cakeFlavor FROM reservations r JOIN cakes c ON r.cake_id = c.id WHERE r.pickup_status = 'WAITING' AND r.res_date = #{date} ORDER BY r.res_date ASC, r.res_time ASC

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.res_time ASC) AS rowNumber, r.*, c.flavor AS cakeFlavor FROM reservations r JOIN cakes c ON r.cake_id = c.id WHERE r.res_date = #{date} AND (r.contact IS NULL OR r.contact != 'ON_SITE') ORDER BY r.res_time ASC

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.res_date DESC, r.res_time DESC) AS rowNumber, r.*, c.flavor AS cakeFlavor FROM reservations r JOIN cakes c ON r.cake_id = c.id ORDER BY r.res_date DESC, r.res_time DESC

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.res_date ASC, r.res_time ASC) AS rowNumber, r.*, c.flavor AS cakeFlavor FROM reservations r JOIN cakes c ON r.cake_id = c.id WHERE r.res_date >= #{fromDate} ORDER BY r.res_date ASC, r.res_time ASC
SELECT r.*, c.flavor AS cakeFlavor FROM reservations r JOIN cakes c ON r.cake_id = c.id WHERE r.res_date = #{date}

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.res_time ASC) AS rowNumber, r.*, c.flavor AS cakeFlavor FROM reservations r JOIN cakes c ON r.cake_id = c.id WHERE r.res_date = #{date} AND (r.contact IS NULL OR r.contact != 'ON_SITE')
ORDER BY r.res_time ASC

SELECT r.cake_size AS cakeSize, c.flavor AS cakeFlavor, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM reservations r JOIN cakes c ON r.cake_id = c.id WHERE r.res_date = #{date} AND r.contact = 'ON_SITE' GROUP BY r.cake_size, c.flavor

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC) AS rowNumber, r.*, c.flavor AS cakeFlavor FROM reservations r JOIN cakes c ON r.cake_id = c.id WHERE r.res_date = #{date} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC) AS rowNumber, r.*, c.flavor AS cakeFlavor FROM reservations r JOIN cakes c ON r.cake_id = c.id WHERE r.res_date >= CURDATE() ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC) AS rowNumber, r.*, c.flavor AS cakeFlavor FROM reservations r JOIN cakes c ON r.cake_id = c.id WHERE r.res_date = #{date} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE res_date = #{resDate} AND HOUR(res_time) = HOUR(#{resTime})
SELECT res_date AS resDate, res_time AS resTime, COUNT(*) AS count FROM reservations WHERE res_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY res_date, res_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations (res_date, res_time, cake_id, contact, paid, note) VALUES (#{resDate}, #{resTime}, #{cakeId}, #{contact}, #{paid}, #{note})

INSERT INTO reservations (res_date, res_time, cake_id, cake_size, make_status, contact, paid, pickup_status, note) VALUES (#{resDate}, #{resTime}, #{cakeId}, #{cakeSize}, #{makeStatus}, #{contact}, #{paid}, #{pickupStatus}, #{note})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM reservations WHERE contact LIKE CONCAT(#{contactPrefix}, '%')
